governmentSchemes.name: PM-KISAN (Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi)
governmentSchemes.benefit: ₹6,000 per year in 3 equal installments of ₹2,000 directly to bank account via DBT.
governmentSchemes.eligibility: All landholding farmer families with cultivable land in their names. Excludes institutional landholders, tax-paying professionals.
requiredDocuments: Bank Account linked with Aadhaar (Aadhaar Seeded)
governmentSchemes.applicationProcess: 1. Visit official pmkisan.gov.in portal. 2. Click "New Farmer Registration". 3. Enter Aadhaar & verify OTP. 4. Enter Land Details & submit. 5. Alternatively register at CSC or local Village Revenue Officer (VRO).

governmentSchemes.name: PMFBY (Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana)
governmentSchemes.benefit: Comprehensive crop loss cover against natural calamities, drought, flood, pests, post-harvest losses. Farmer premium is only 2% for Kharif, 1.5% for Rabi, and 5% for Commercial/Horticultural crops.
governmentSchemes.eligibility: Farmers growing notified crops in notified areas. Non-loanee farmers need valid tenancy/land records.
requiredDocuments: Sowing Certificate / Declaration from Revenue/Agri Officer
governmentSchemes.applicationProcess: 1. Register on pmfby.gov.in or via bank branch / CSC center before the season cut-off date. 2. In case of crop loss, report within 72 hours via Crop Insurance App or toll-free number 1800-180-1551.

governmentSchemes.name: Kisan Credit Card (KCC) Scheme
governmentSchemes.targetBeneficiary: Individual Farmers, Joint Borrowers, Tenant Farmers, SHGs
governmentSchemes.benefit: Subsidized institutional credit up to ₹3,00,000 at an effective interest rate of just 4% per annum (7% basic minus 3% prompt repayment incentive). Collateral-free limit up to ₹1,60,000.
governmentSchemes.eligibility: Owner cultivators, tenant farmers, oral lessees, and sharecroppers cultivating notified land.
governmentSchemes.applicationProcess: 1. Apply at any Public Sector / Commercial Bank, Regional Rural Bank (RRB), or Cooperative Bank. 2. Can also apply online via JanSamarth portal or SBI Yono Krishi.

governmentSchemes.name: PM-KUSUM (Pradhan Mantri Kisan Urja Suraksha evam Utthaan Mahabhiyan)
governmentSchemes.targetBeneficiary: Individual Farmers, Water User Associations, FPOs
governmentSchemes.benefit: Up to 60% subsidy (30% Central + 30% State) for setting up Standalone Solar Agriculture Pumps (3 HP to 10 HP) and solarizing existing grid-connected pumps. Farmer pays only 10% cash.
governmentSchemes.eligibility: Farmers having cultivable land with a water source (borewell/well) needing off-grid or solarized pump.
governmentSchemes.applicationProcess: Apply through State Renewable Energy Agency portal (e.g. REDA, MEDA, TSREDCO, APREDA) or State Agriculture Department.

governmentSchemes.name: SMAM (Sub-Mission on Agricultural Mechanization)
governmentSchemes.targetBeneficiary: Small & Marginal Farmers, SC/ST, Women Farmers, CHC Centers
governmentSchemes.benefit: 40% to 50% financial subsidy on purchase of Tractors, Power Tillers, Rotavators, Combine Harvesters, Drone Sprayers, and Laser Land Levelers. 80% subsidy for setting up Custom Hiring Centers (CHCs).
governmentSchemes.eligibility: Farmers registered on the DBT Agri-Machinery portal with valid Aadhaar and land records.
governmentSchemes.applicationProcess: 1. Register on agrimachinery.nic.in. 2. Select machinery manufacturer & dealer. 3. Receive permit/approval SMS. 4. Purchase and submit invoice for direct subsidy credit.

governmentSchemes.name: National Soil Health Card Scheme
governmentSchemes.benefit: Free soil testing report covering 12 parameters (pH, EC, Organic Carbon, Nitrogen, Phosphorus, Potassium, Sulphur, Zinc, Iron, Copper, Manganese, Boron) with customized fertilizer dosage.
governmentSchemes.applicationProcess: Soil samples are collected free of cost by Village Agriculture Assistants or farmers can submit samples to nearest Krishi Vigyan Kendra (KVK). View cards on soilhealth.dac.gov.in.

governmentSchemes.name: Rythu Bharosa / Rythu Bandhu Investment Support
governmentSchemes.benefit: Direct financial investment support of ₹10,000 to ₹15,000 per acre per year credited before Kharif and Rabi seasons to purchase quality seeds, fertilizers, and farm inputs.
governmentSchemes.eligibility: Resident farmers with verified digital land records (Dharani / Meebhoomi).
governmentSchemes.applicationProcess: Enrolled automatically via Dharani / Revenue land records or through Village Agriculture Assistant verification.

governmentSchemes.name: Agriculture Infrastructure Fund (AIF)
governmentSchemes.benefit: Medium to long term debt financing for post-harvest management infrastructure (Cold stores, Warehouses, Silos, Sorting/Grading units) with 3% per annum interest subvention up to ₹2 Crores.
requiredDocuments: Land ownership / lease deed for site
governmentSchemes.applicationProcess: Apply online on agriinfra.dac.gov.in portal. Selected loan proposals forwarded to participating banks with automated 3% interest relief.

learningArticles.title: How to Manage Yellowing Leaves in Tomato & Chilli (Early vs Late Blight)
learningArticles.summary: Learn how to differentiate nitrogen deficiency from fungal blights and safe organic bio-fungicide treatments like Trichoderma & Copper Oxychloride.
learningArticles.content:
### Understanding Yellow Leaves in Solanaceous Crops
Yellowing in leaves can arise from 3 distinct origins:

1. **Nutrient Deficiency (Nitrogen/Iron/Magnesium)**: Older bottom leaves turn pale yellow evenly while veins remain green (Chlorosis).
2. **Early Blight (Alternaria solani)**: Dark brown concentric target-like rings with yellow halos starting from lower leaves.
3. **Late Blight (Phytophthora infestans)**: Water-soaked dark brown irregular lesions that rapidly turn greasy and rot during cool, humid nights.

#### Practical Action Plan:
- **Drainage**: Ensure no water stagnation around the root collar.
- **Organic Bio-spray**: Spray *Pseudomonas fluorescens* @ 5g/Litre or Neem Oil 10,000 ppm @ 3ml/L.
- **Chemical Option (Follow Label Safely)**: Mancozeb 75 WP @ 2.5g/L or Metalaxyl 8% + Mancozeb 64% WP @ 2g/L.
- **Always observe a 7-day harvest waiting period after chemical sprays.**

learningArticles.title: Step-by-Step Drip Irrigation & Water Saving Guide for Small Farms
learningArticles.summary: Maximize crop yields while cutting water and labor costs by 60% through low-cost gravity and inline drip systems.
learningArticles.content:
### Why Drip Irrigation is Essential for Future Farming
Drip irrigation delivers water directly to the plant root zone with 90-95% application efficiency, compared to only 45-50% for flood furrow methods.

#### Key Setup Steps:
1. **Header Unit**: Screen filter (120 mesh) or disc filter to prevent dripper clogging from sand or algae.
2. **Main & Sub-main Line**: High density PVC or HDPE pipes buried 1.5 feet underground.
3. **Laterals & Emitters**: 16mm inline lateral tubes with drippers spaced at 30cm or 40cm (2 to 4 Litres per hour discharge).
4. **Fertigation Venturi Injector**: Allows precise feeding of water-soluble fertilizers (19:19:19, 0:52:34) directly into irrigation water.

#### Maintenance Tips:
- Flush lateral end caps once every 15 days for 3 minutes.
- Carry out acid treatment (Hydrochloric or Nitric acid @ pH 4.0) once a season to dissolve carbonate scaling.

learningArticles.title: Complete Kisan Credit Card (KCC) Loan Guide & Interest Subvention
learningArticles.summary: How to get institutional bank credit at 4% effective interest rate, avoid money-lenders, and understand insurance coverage.
learningArticles.content:
### Kisan Credit Card (KCC) Explained Simply
The Kisan Credit Card offers a flexible revolving cash credit limit calculated based on scale of finance per acre for each crop plus 10% for post-harvest expenses and 20% for farm asset maintenance.

#### Key Features:
- **Base Interest Rate**: 7% per annum.
- **Prompt Repayment Incentive (PRI)**: 3% rebate by Government of India.
- **Effective Final Interest**: **Only 4% per annum!**
- **Collateral Free**: No land mortgage needed for loans up to ₹1,60,000 (extended to ₹3,00,000 under tie-up agreements).
- **Insurance**: Built-in accident insurance coverage.

problemReports.symptoms: Yellow mosaic mottling on young top leaves with leaf curling and stunted shoot growth.
problemReports.aiDiagnosis: Suspected Tomato Leaf Curl Virus (ToLCV) transmitted by Bemisia tabaci (Whitefly)
suggestedNextSteps: Install yellow sticky traps (15 per acre) to trap whitefly vectors
Spray Neem Oil (10,000 ppm) @ 3ml/L or bio-insecticide Beauveria bassiana
Rogue out and safely bury severely stunted non-productive infected plants

problemReports.symptoms: Circular reddish-brown spots with shot-hole appearance on middle canopy leaves.
problemReports.aiDiagnosis: Bacterial Blight / Angular Leaf Spot (Xanthomonas albilineans / campestris)
suggestedNextSteps: Avoid sprinkler irrigation or excessive overhead moisture
Spray Copper Oxychloride 50 WP @ 3g/L + Streptocycline 1g/10L water
Maintain balanced potassium fertilization to bolster plant cell wall defense
